startup.title: Startup Behavior
startup.description: Control what happens when the application starts and when switching between view layouts.
startup.startupViewTooltip: Select which main view opens automatically when launching ynoTV.
startup.rememberLastChannelsDescription: Save active streams per slot so they restore when returning to Multiview layout.
startup.reopenLastOnStartup: Reopen last active channels on app startup
startup.reopenLastOnStartupDescription: Automatically tune back into your last watched streams when opening the application.
startup.rule1: Channels are automatically saved when you switch layouts or close the app
startup.rule2: 2x2 Grid and Big Top + Bottom Bar share the same 4 video sources
startup.rule3: Picture-in-Picture uses the Main view + Slot 2
startup.rule4: Main View only uses the primary player

playback.hwdecOverriddenHint: A custom --hwdec parameter was detected in your parameters below. Your custom parameter will take priority over this toggle.
playback.hwdecHintSuffix: to MPV to offload live video decoding to your GPU. Can be overridden using custom parameters below.
playback.mpvParamsHint: One parameter per line. These flags are passed to MPV on startup.
playback.restartMessage: For playback settings to take effect, the app needs to restart.
playback.restartQuestion: Would you like to restart now?
playback.loadingScreenSub: Show an overlay with a loading spinner and channel name when a stream starts or buffers.
playback.eventReconnectSub: React immediately to stream errors (EOF, HTTP errors, MPV crashes). Disable if you experience overly aggressive reconnects on slow or unstable sources — the watchdog will still detect dead streams based on playback progress.
playback.stallDetectionSub: Periodically poll MPV to detect stalled or frozen streams based on playback progress. Disable if you prefer only event-based detection, or if the watchdog causes false reconnects on slow streams.
playback.stallTimeoutSub: Seconds of no position change before a stream is considered stalled. Lower values react faster but may false-trigger on slow servers.
playback.stallWarning: Values below 8s may cause false retries on slow IPTV servers or streams that take time to buffer. If you notice unexpected reconnects on healthy streams, increase this value.
playback.maxRetriesSub: Maximum number of reconnection attempts before giving up and showing a permanent error.
playback.castSupportSub: Allows scanning your local network for Chromecast devices. Enabling this will prompt the operating system for local network and firewall permissions.
playback.rewriteTs: Rewrite TS to M3U8 for Cast
playback.rewriteTsSub: Automatically rewrite `.ts` stream URLs to HLS `.m3u8` when casting. Turn this on only if your IPTV provider supports HLS at the rewritten URL. Disabling this casts the raw stream as MPEG-TS (`video/mp2t`).
playback.castActiveWarning: Google Cast discovery is active. The application will scan the local network for compatible Chromecast devices. Ensure your device is on the same Wi-Fi/local network.
playback.externalPlayerDesc: Configure an external media player (e.g. mpv, VLC) to stream channels directly. When the EPG popout mode is set to "External", clicking any channel will send its stream to the configured player.
playback.playerPathHint: Full path to your player executable (e.g. C:\Program Files\mpv\mpv.exe or C:\Program Files\VideoLAN\VLC\vlc.exe).
playback.reusePlayerSub: When enabled, switching channels will close the previous player before opening a new one, instead of spawning multiple player windows.
playback.popoutDesc: Control how the standalone popout MPV player behaves when activated.
playback.stopMain: Stop main player when popout opens
playback.stopMainSub: When enabled, the embedded player in the main window will stop when a popout is opened. Disable this to keep both playing simultaneously.
playback.alwaysOnTopSub: Keep the popout window above all other windows. Useful for watching while browsing.
playback.popoutHwdecHint: Automatically passes --hwdec=auto and --vo=gpu to the popout player instance to offload live video decoding to your GPU.
playback.extraParamsSub: Pass custom command-line arguments to the popout MPV instance. These are applied each time a new popout is opened.
playback.extraParamsHint: One parameter per line. These flags are passed to the popout MPV on startup.
playback.skipIntroDesc: Configure the IntroDB-powered skip intro feature for series episodes. When a valid intro entry exists from the IntroDB API, the app can show a skip button or skip automatically.
playback.autoSkipSub: When enabled, the intro will be skipped automatically as soon as it starts — no button needed. Disable to show the skip button instead.
playback.buttonDurationSub: How many seconds the skip button stays visible before auto-dismissing (only applies when Automatic Intro Skip is disabled).
playback.catchupDesc: Adjust the playback settings for catch-up (timeshift) programs to prevent shows or sports from being cut off.
playback.startPaddingSub: Minutes to play before the EPG scheduled start time. This lets you scrub back to the very beginning if needed.
playback.endPaddingSub: Minutes of extra time to append after the scheduled program end. Avoids cut-offs for slightly delayed programs.
playback.continuePlayingSub: Allows the player to keep streaming past the program end time indefinitely (up to 12 hours) on the channel. Highly recommended for sports.
playback.vodDesc: Configure playback settings and preferences for Video on Demand (VOD) content.
playback.autoPlayNextSub: Automatically play the next episode of a VOD Series when the current episode ends. If it's the end of a season, it will automatically start the first episode of the next season.
playback.showSourceBadgeSub: Display the provider source badge for VOD Movies and Series cards in Recently Watched on the home page, All Movies/Series page, and Recent page.

livetv.epgVisibleHoursSub: Customize the number of hours visible in the grid (Automatic uses 2-5 hours dynamically based on width).
livetv.epgClockFormatSub: Select between 12-hour (AM/PM) and 24-hour clock display across EPG grid, search results, watchlist, and recordings.
livetv.darkenCurrent: Make EPG Current airing program blocks darker
livetv.darkenCurrentSub: When enabled, the currently airing program in the EPG will have a deeper/darker highlight.
livetv.highlightCurrentSub: When enabled, a border with the accent color will outline the currently playing channel row in the EPG.
livetv.metadataBadgesDescription: Enable or disable metadata badges displayed on channel rows in the EPG grid.

nuvio.title: Nuvio
nuvio.subtitle: Nuvio Cloud Account & Sync
nuvio.description: Connect your Nuvio account to synchronize your watch history, watchlist, profiles, and addons seamlessly.
nuvio.cloudSettingsDesc: Configure Debrid caching services and TMDB metadata enrichment synced directly with Nuvio's cloud profile.
nuvio.disclaimer: Disclaimer: ynoTV is an independent open source desktop client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nuvio. Your login credentials are only used to connect to Nuvio's servers directly to sync — ynoTV never stores or transmits them.
nuvio.deleteProfileConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete profile "{{name}}"? This deletes all synced data for this profile.
nuvio.homeLayoutDesc: Customize which catalog rows (from your collections or addons) appear on your homepage and rearrange their display order.
nuvio.hideUnreleasedSub: Filter out movies/shows that haven't aired or released yet.
nuvio.hideUnderlineSub: Hide the horizontal indicator line beneath catalog titles.
nuvio.landscapePostersSub: Display posters in catalogs in landscape aspect ratio.
nuvio.continueWatchingStyleSub: Choose how continue watching items are displayed.
nuvio.heroBannerSourcesSub: Select up to 2 catalogs to feature in the hero banner at the top of the home page. Items will be randomly picked from these catalogs.
nuvio.noCatalogs: No catalogs available. Install addons first.
nuvio.noCatalogItems: No collections or catalogs available. Install addons or create collections first.
nuvio.enablePluginsSub: Use installed Nuvio scrapers when looking for media streams.
nuvio.groupByRepoSub: Group streams by their originating plugin scraper repo in the stream picker.
nuvio.hoverDetailsSub: Show hover cards with details when hovering over items in Nuvio catalogs.
nuvio.traktDesc: Check your Trakt connection status and configure Trakt catalogs for Nuvio.
nuvio.autoplayDesc: Automatically select and play a stream when Nuvio detail page opens, or when a new episode is selected.
nuvio.autoStreamSelectionSub: How to pick a stream when auto-playing.
nuvio.selectionTimeoutSub: Wait N seconds before auto-selecting a stream. 0 = instant.
nuvio.sourceScopeSub: Which sources to consider for auto-play.
nuvio.regexPatternSub: Match stream title/description/URL against this regex (e.g. (?=.*1080p)(?!.*cam)).
nuvio.allowedAddonsSub: Select which addons are allowed to auto-play.
nuvio.allowedPluginsSub: Select which scraper plugins are allowed to auto-play.
nuvio.cacheDesc: Cache addon and plugin fetch results. When returning to the same detail page within the set time, previously fetched streams will load instantly.
nuvio.cacheResultsSub: Enable caching of stream query results.
nuvio.badgesDesc: Show quality, codec, HDR, and audio badges on Nuvio stream links, or import custom rules.
nuvio.enableBadgesSub: Toggle stream badges on or off for Nuvio streams.
nuvio.showFileSizeSub: Display the video file size badge if available.
nuvio.badgePositionSub: Render badges above or below the Nuvio stream title.
nuvio.allowedAddonsModalDesc: Select which Stremio addons are allowed to be auto-played. If none are selected, all addons are allowed.
nuvio.allowedPluginsModalDesc: Select which scraper plugins are allowed to be auto-played. If none are selected, all plugins are allowed.

discord.title: Discord Rich Presence Settings
discord.description: Display what you are watching on your Discord profile, complete with title info, live progress bar, and show posters. Requires the Discord desktop app to be running.
discord.showOnDiscordHint: Broadcasting active activity to your Discord profile.
discord.hideTitleDesc: Show 'Watching something' with no show name or poster artwork.
discord.showPausedDesc: Keep the presence visible when media playback is paused.
discord.showBrowsingDesc: Display 'Browsing ynotv' when nothing is playing.
discord.showPosterDesc: Reveal movie or show artwork. Turning off keeps the title but hides the poster.
discord.showTimestampDesc: Display the live progress bar showing how far into the title you are.

proxy.title: SOCKS5 Proxy Configuration
proxy.description: Route all outgoing application network traffic—including stream feeds, EPG guides, metadata requests, and VOD updates—through a secure SOCKS5 proxy server.
proxy.enableProxyHint: Toggle the proxy connection. When disabled, traffic flows directly via your default ISP.
proxy.serverHint: Enter the host/IP and port of your proxy server. Scheme is automatically resolved (defaults to DNS-safe socks5h:// to prevent local DNS leaks).

optimization.title: Hardware Acceleration
optimization.description: Configure GPU hardware acceleration for interface rendering and window compositing.
optimization.enableGpuHint: Offloads UI compositing, glass animations, and layout rendering to your graphics processor (integrated or dedicated GPU). Keep enabled for lowest CPU usage. If you experience screen flickering or display driver crashes, you can disable this option.
optimization.themeDescription: Customize theme rendering performance. If you experience high GPU usage, interface lag, or frame drops, you can disable individual intensive effects here.
optimization.disableBlurHint: Removes the backdrop blur effect from cards, menus, and overlays. Significantly increases UI responsiveness on integrated or older graphics processors.
optimization.epgDescription: Optimize EPG guide performance and loading speeds, especially when using large playlists.
optimization.enableLazyHint: Only loads EPG programs for the visible time window (plus a small scroll buffer) rather than loading the entire EPG guide database upfront. Recommended for large playlists to reduce memory usage.
optimization.disableTransitionsHint: Disables shadow filters and CSS transform animations on program cells when scrolling through the EPG timeline.
optimization.reduceGpuLayersHint: Adds paint and layout containment to guide rows and program grids so scrolling repaints less of the EPG at once.
optimization.disableChannelFade: Disable EPG Channel Name Gradient Fade
optimization.disableChannelFadeHint: Removes the soft gradient fade on the right edge of long channel names. Visual trade-off: long names show ellipsis (…) instead of a gradient fade.

cache.title: Cache Time Shift
cache.description: When enabled, MPV keeps a rolling in-memory buffer of the live stream so you can rewind and fast-forward within the cached window.
cache.enableTimeshiftSub: Allows rewinding live TV up to the cache window. Takes effect on next restart.
cache.liveBufferOffsetHint: When pressing "Go Live" during time shift, seek to this many seconds behind the live edge. Helps prevent buffer stalls on some networks.
cache.timeshiftNote: ⚠️ Changes take effect on next restart. Buffer lives only in RAM and is reset on channel change.

security.title: Network Security
security.description: By default, ynoTV blocks requests to local network addresses to prevent malicious playlists from probing your internal network (SSRF protection).
security.allowLanHint: Enable this if your IPTV provider runs on your local network (e.g., Plex, Jellyfin, or a NAS). Only enable if you trust your playlist sources.
security.disclaimer: Blocked addresses: localhost, 127.x.x.x, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, and cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.x.x).

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Click on a shortcut to rebind it. Press Esc to cancel listening (unless rebinding Close).
shortcuts.resetMessage: Are you sure you want to reset all keyboard shortcuts to their default values?

exportImport.title: System Backup & Restoration
exportImport.description: Export your configuration to a JSON file to transfer between devices or create backups.
exportImport.exportDescription: Save your current setup to a file.
exportImport.exportWarning: Warning: The exported file contains your source passwords, Stremio settings, and API keys in plain text. Keep it safe.
exportImport.importDescription: Restore configuration from a previously exported file.
exportImport.importWarning: Caution: This will replace all your current sources and settings.
exportImport.confirmMessage: WARNING: Importing will overwrite all current sources and settings. Application data will be cleared. Are you sure you want to continue?

debug.title: Debug Logging
debug.description: Enable verbose logging to help diagnose issues with video playback, network requests, and application errors. Logs are written to a file that you can share when reporting bugs.
debug.enableLoggingHint: When enabled, detailed logs from mpv, the renderer, and main process are written to a file. This may slightly impact performance.
debug.retentionHint: Older logs are automatically removed when the app starts.
debug.disclaimer: Debug logs may contain sensitive information like stream URLs. Only share logs with trusted parties when troubleshooting issues.
